categories.main_business_segments: Nanya New Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of copper clad laminates (CCL) and prepregs, which are composite materials used in printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their product portfolio includes ordinary FR-4, lead-free FR-4, halogen-free lead-free FR-4, high-frequency high-speed laminates, automotive laminates, energy laminates, HDI, and IC packaging substrates. The company serves various end markets such as consumer electronics, computers, communications, data centers, automotive electronics, aerospace, and industrial control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies focus on advanced formulation techniques for various laminate types including lead-free, halogen-free, high-frequency, high-speed, automotive, high thermal conductivity, HDI, low CTE, and IC packaging substrates. Key production technologies include filler dispersion, resin impregnation, ultra-thin prepreg production, voltage resistance control, dimensional stability control, and thickness uniformity enhancement for high-frequency products. The company also employs comprehensive quality control systems and has developed proprietary manufacturing processes to meet stringent customer requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nanya New Material serves major PCB manufacturers and end customers in sectors such as telecommunications, AI servers, data centers, automotive electronics, and consumer electronics. Key customers include well-known PCB companies like Kinwong, Unimicron, Shenzhen Scenic, Deep South Circuit, and major terminal clients such as Huawei, ZTE, Inspur, and Samsung. The company’s products are widely used in applications like 5G communications, AI computing, automotive smart systems, and high-end electronic devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai, Jiangxi, Guangdong, and Jiangsu provinces. It has also established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Thailand to expand its global footprint. Overseas market development includes localized teams and representative offices to enhance competitiveness in international high-end markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanya New Material operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing key electronic materials such as copper clad laminates and prepregs that serve as foundational substrates for PCB production. The company maintains strategic relationships with upstream raw material suppliers and downstream PCB manufacturers, positioning itself as a critical materials supplier within the electronics manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on continuous innovation in high-performance electronic materials, emphasizing R&D in high-speed, high-frequency, automotive, HDI, IC packaging substrates, and high thermal conductivity laminates. It invests significantly in developing proprietary formulations and production technologies to meet evolving market demands, particularly for 5G, AI, automotive electronics, and data center applications. The company also pursues digital transformation through intelligent manufacturing systems and talent development to sustain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Nanya New Material generates revenue primarily through direct sales of copper clad laminates and prepregs to PCB manufacturers and electronic component producers. The sales model is predominantly direct sales, with a small portion through distributors. Revenue is recognized at the point of product delivery and customer acceptance, with pricing based on product specifications and market conditions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the copper clad laminate industry in China, ranked among the top ten globally with a market share of approximately 3.2%. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers, including foreign enterprises that dominate the high-end product segment. Nanya New Material differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, localized supply chain advantages, and strategic partnerships with major PCB and terminal customers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.36 billion, representing a 12.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 50.32 million, recovering from a loss in the previous year. Total assets grew modestly to RMB 4.57 billion. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory supported by increased sales of high-margin products and improved operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanya New Material emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering a wide range of laminate types tailored for diverse applications, backed by advanced proprietary formulation and manufacturing technologies. The company highlights its ability to deliver high-performance, reliable, and environmentally compliant materials that meet stringent customer certifications and industry standards. Its value proposition includes strong technical support, flexible production capacity, and a customer-centric approach that fosters long-term partnerships with leading PCB manufacturers and end users.
